name: Cybersecurity Research
description: Combines the S2 hardware resource policy (conservative, evidence-based CPU/memory/storage policy biased for stable virtualization behavior) with the S5 cybersecurity-workspace software layer: a compact Host Cyber Light diagnostic/capture (tshark/wireshark-common)/reverse-engineering baseline, packet-capture privilege modeling, isolated toolbox detection (reusing S3's Podman/Distrobox architecture), and read-only KVM/VM capability detection. The Wireshark GUI is host-appropriate but intentionally NOT part of the default install (its Qt6/GTK dependency weight is far heavier than tshark alone - see docs/cyber/host-tooling.md); a user may still install it. Specialized/offensive tooling (password cracking, exploit frameworks, wireless auditing, full Kali) is classified toolbox- or VM-tier, never installed on the host. No package is installed, no container/VM is created, no packet is captured, and no network is scanned by this repository - see docs/cyber/architecture.md and docs/cyber/known-limitations.md.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2/S5; serein hardware plan and serein cyber plan are both read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md and docs/cyber/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
